extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral researchers and applicants for the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships (Canada)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and high-level program requirements for applicants to the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships (Canada), including eligibility categories, award value and duration, and research-area coverage. This page is a program landing/summary directing applicants to the full application guide and related details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value & duration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award provides $70,000 annually for two non-renewable years. (Shown on the page as the program's funding level and term.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility — Citizenship: Canadian citizens; Permanent residents of Canada; Foreign citizens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The landing page explicitly lists all three citizenship statuses as categories of eligibility. Applicants should confirm detailed residency/citizenship rules in the full application guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible areas of research
rubrics_metrics.description: Areas of research: Health research; Natural sciences and/or engineering; Social sciences and/or humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program covers research across health, natural sciences/engineering, and social sciences/humanities. Applicants should verify discipline-specific eligibility and classification in the application guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application availability / program status
rubrics_metrics.description: We are no longer accepting applications for the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships program. Please refer to the Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program web page for information regarding the new harmonized program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This landing page indicates the Banting program application intake is closed and that applicants should consult the Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program for the updated/harmonized process. Applicants must follow the current program guidance rather than this closed intake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to application guide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs applicants to an application guide for full details. All procedural requirements, assessment criteria, deadlines, and submission rules are expected to be in the application guide rather than on this summary page.
